title: secure-orch sign policy (plan 0042 §7)
description: Operator-authored policy envelope for the secure-orch agent's auto-sign decisions. Strict: unknown fields fail validation; a parse or schema failure pauses auto-signing (fail closed).

renewal.description: Auto-sign content-identical renewals. Phase-1 default: true.

benign.description: Auto-sign benign changes within benign_bounds. Phase-1 default: false (held + would_auto_sign shadow audit); phase 2 flips this to true.

price_delta_max_pct.description: Price changes in either direction within this percentage are benign. Decreases are bounded too: a fat-fingered 99% cut holds for review.

allow_tuple_removal.description: Treat a disappearing (capability_id, offering_id) tuple as benign — removal reduces exposure.

items.description: Explicit lower-case domain suffix; matches a host equal to the entry or ending in '.'+entry. No wildcards.

worker_url_domain_allowlist.description: A changed worker_url is benign only when its host matches an entry.

max_auto_signs_per_hour.description: Sliding 1-hour cap on auto-signs. An unbounded rate is not expressible.

on_breach.description: Breaching the cap stops ALL auto-signing (renewals included) until the operator clears it.

stability_window_seconds.description: How long a pulled candidate's ETag must stay unchanged before the agent acts on it.

renewal_threshold_fraction.description: Fraction of the manifest TTL below which an unchanged candidate classifies as renewal. Keep aligned with the coordinator's --renewal-threshold (both default to 1/3).
